Subject: Your anticipatory bail matter - Anticipatory Bail Application No. 2613/2025

Dear Ms. Mishra,

Thank you for meeting us on 14 August 2025 about your dispute with Ishita Ahuja. As we understand it, the complaint turns a business disagreement into a criminal case. The matter is listed before the Mangaluru Sessions Court.

Our advice is to argue that the dispute is civil in nature and offer to cooperate with the investigation. Please collect the partnership papers and the correspondence with the complainant and send copies to this office.

Regards,
Adv. Aditi Ranganathan
